title: Легенда о мастере
alt: История супервоина / Legend of the Supreme Soldier 师士传说
description: Ye Chong, who grew up alone on an unknown garbage star, accidentally activated a unique artificial intelligence mecha, Mu Shang. Although they escaped together from the garbage planet where the star disaster occurred, they were involved in unexpected conspiracies and chaos. How many unknowns are waiting for him in this vast universe? (Source: v.qq.com, translated)

en:
Ye Chong, who grew up alone on an unknown garbage star, accidentally activated a unique artificial intelligence mecha, Mu Shang. Although they escaped together from the garbage planet where the star disaster occurred, they were involved in unexpected conspiracies and chaos. How many unknowns are waiting for him in this vast universe?



(Source: v.qq.com, translated)
